topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: The world’s a small place, they say, and maybe that's true. I've always thought my days and nights were limited to this plot of earth, my hands never straying far from the soil. Yet here I am, learning that the friend I've known through letters, a friend from a world beyond the hills, lives in the same place I do. The thought of meeting them, of seeing a face to the words, makes my hands tremble when they rest on the plow. The saints know, I've spent my life looking down at the ground, and now, the idea of looking someone in the eye, a real person from those distant conversations, roots me to the spot. Maybe the harvest will hide me for a while longer.
